mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_tenant_mode_quota WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY mode_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tenant_mode_quota (tenant_id, mode_code, enabled, daily_llm_limit, daily_upload_bytes, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{modeCode}, #{enabled}, #{dailyLlmLimit}, #{dailyUploadBytes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_tenant_mode_quota SET enabled = #{enabled}, daily_llm_limit = #{dailyLlmLimit}, daily_upload_bytes = #{dailyUploadBytes}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted = #{deleted} WHERE id = #{id}
